tool_input.command:
$base="http://zentao-biz.zhi.com"
$body=@{account='tiany';password='Field123456'} | ConvertTo-Json
$r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$base/api.php/v1/tokens" -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -UseBasicParsing
$tok=($r.Content|ConvertFrom-Json).token
Write-Output "TOK_LEN=$($tok.Length)"
$hd=@{'Token'=$tok}
$r2=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$base/api.php/v1/files/21210" -Headers $hd -UseBasicParsing
$bytes=$r2.RawContentStream.ToArray()
$out="D:\repository\苏州市房地产监测V3\.tmp-bug6070.png"
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($out,$bytes)
Write-Output "SAVED=$out SIZE=$($bytes.Length)"
tool_input.description: Download bug 6070 screenshot via REST token
